text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [ALERT] 03:12 UTC — sustained spike in `function_call` tail latency and structured-output errors in us-east-1. 95p latency for fn-invoke up to ~18s, error-rate from 0.2% -> 4%. Auto-scaling hasn't kept up on a few dedicated pools. Paging oncall.
oncall-alex: on it. I'm seeing increased `kv-cache` evictions too. Isolate?
sre-jordan: quick triage — is this traffic pattern wide or concentrated to certain customers/routes?
eng-meera: metrics indicate ~70% of error traffic is for routes that request `tool_call` + `structured_json` together. Looks like the structured output post-process is timing out during heavy bursty tool invocations.
oncall-alex: plan propose: 1) quickly throttle/shape incoming tool/function calls cluster-wide; 2) disable `structured_json` output mode for hosted customers temporarily; 3) apply per-tenant stricter quotas for the top heavy callers. Goal: reduce tail latency and kv cache churn. Thoughts?
product-lena: need to understand customer impact — which customers rely on tool-calls being synchronous? we should avoid breaking critical enterprise customers if possible.
ops-ryan: we can do targeted quota adjustments by customer id. Recommend starting with a soft throttle (limit burst/rps) rather than hard disable.
oncall-alex: executing soft global shaping first. Applying circuit at the edge: `x-edge: set header X-RL-LIMIT=toolcall=10rps` (syntax via edge-control).
bot-deploy: Deploy request accepted — rollout job 84321 queued by oncall-alex.
oncall-alex: ran edge command:```
# edge-control CLI
edge-control set-rate --route "/v1/tool-invoke" --rate 10 --burst 20 --scope hosted-us-east-1
```
noncall-alex: initial results: p95 down to ~9s, error-rate still elevated but trending down.
sre-jordan: while shaping stabilizes, let's flip structured output off for hosted default profile. Eng toggle is `FEATURE_STRUCTURED_OUTPUT=false` in config service.
eng-meera: caution — some customers expect structured JSON for tool calls (webhooks/parse pipelines). We should scope to non-enterprise plans first.
oncall-alex: doing per-plan toggle. Command:```
# config-service
curl -X PATCH https://config.internal/api/v1/features \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"structured_output.default": false, "structured_output.enterprise": true}'
```
bot-deploy: Config updated by oncall-alex (rollout id: cfg-2026-04-02-64). 10% canary -> 100% in 45s.
customer-support-sam: prepping canned message for impacted non-enterprise users: "We're temporarily disabling structured JSON outputs in Hosted while we mitigate an infrastructure issue causing timeouts. You'll still get plain text responses. We're working to restore within the hour." Want to confirm before send.
product-lena: ok to send to self-serve customers only. Do not notify enterprise customers yet.
ops-ryan: meanwhile I'm patching per-tenant quotas for top offenders. Running script:```
# reduce burst for heavy tenants
python tools/tenancy_quota.py --tenant-ids 4732,9981,12902 --set-rate 5
```
eng-meera: FYI, disabling structured output reduces CPU and KV-access patterns significantly on synthetic tests — looks promising.
sre-jordan: monitor RDNS and tracing for regressions. Set eval alert for error-rate > 1% over 5m.
oncall-alex: alert rule created: `ops/error_rate_toolcalls_us_east` set to 1% threshold.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0402-22. Severity: S3. Pages: oncall-alex, sre-jordan.
customer-support-sam: sent notice to impacted users (self-serve): https://internal.cases/notice/INC-2026-0402-22 (template posted).
eng-meera: we should consider a graded rollback path: once p95 < 3s for 10m, re-enable structured_output for a subset and monitor.
product-lena: agree. please compile list of customers we re-enable first (preferably those with low traffic).
ops-ryan: moved three tenants to lowered quotas — observed immediate drop in calls from them and latency improved in those shards.
oncall-alex: metrics now: p95 2.7s, errors 0.28%. Good trend. I'll keep the shaping + structured turned off for non-enterprise for now.
eng-meera: creating follow-up eval to run end-to-end integration with tool-call + structured output on a canary model to ensure the path is healthy before full re-enable.
sre-jordan: prepping handoff notes for next shift.
oncall-alex: Handoff summary for next oncall:
- Incident INC-2026-0402-22 opened at 03:12 UTC.
- Mitigations applied: edge rate-limit on `/v1/tool-invoke` (10rps), feature flag `structured_output` disabled for non-enterprise customers, tightened quotas for top tenants.
- Current state: p95 ~2.7s, error-rate ~0.28%. Canary config rollout completed.
- Action items: monitor `ops/error_rate_toolcalls_us_east` (1% threshold), consider gradual re-enable (small cohort) when stable 10m.
- Contacts: eng-meera (model/structured path), ops-ryan (quota changes), sre-jordan (infra/tracing).
oncall-alex: handing to sre-jordan for overnight monitoring. tagging @sre-jordan — you're up.
sre-jordan: acknowledged. I'll watch the traces and the canary rollout. If error-rate creeps >1% revert everything to pre-incident state and escalate to ENG.
bot-deploy: Canary re-enable workflow scheduled at 04:50 UTC (if healthy).
customer-support-sam: I'll continue to update the incident page and notify customers if anything changes.
product-lena: thanks all. quick retro later to discuss whether we need more graceful degradation (e.g., queueing tool calls instead of hard disable).
sre-jordan: copy. starting shift watch.
incidental-note: reactions: :thumbsup: from product-lena, :eyes: from eng-meera, :coffee: from ops-ryan.
